newsitem.title: USA: Ladenburg Thalmann revamps research, sales depts.
newsitem.headline: Ladenburg Thalmann revamps research, sales depts.

text.p: Investment bank Ladenburg Thalmann & Co Inc said on Wednesday that it has restructured its research and institutional sales departments.
Barry Sahgal, chief equity strategist will oversee the firm's insititional research sales efforts, the company said.
Managing director Griff Peck has overall responsibility for the firm's institutional trading operations, Ladenburg said.
Sahgal and Jay Petschek, senior managing director will jointly manage the firm's research deparment, Ladenburg Thalmann said.
Peck and managing director Jim Trieste jointly manage the firm's over-the-counter activities, Ladenburg said.
